prompt:
Style: a texture sheet for a cel-shaded (toon-shaded) 3D video game. Nine square surface textures arranged in an exact 3 by 3 grid of equal squares, separated by straight, even gutters of pure black (#000000), with a pure black border around the whole sheet. Every square is filled edge to edge with one surface material seen straight on (orthographic, no perspective, no objects, no frame). Hand-painted toon texture style: each square is one flat, clean base colour with a few bold, clean dark ink lines for the important shapes (cracks, joints, grain) and a few lighter flat strokes; no gradients, no photographic detail, no noise, no fine grain, no brush texture. Flat, even, neutral lighting: no shading, no highlights, no shadows, no light direction (the game shades them). Each texture tiles seamlessly across the left/right and top/bottom edges and has even brightness.
Row 1, left to right: (1) grey-violet coastal rock with a few angular crack lines; (2) short green grass with small scattered tuft strokes; (3) blue-grey roof slates in overlapping horizontal rows.
Row 2: (4) warm orange-brown wooden planks running horizontally with grain lines and a few knots; (5) beige fieldstone wall of rounded stones with mortar lines; (6) large rectangular paving stones with thin joints and a few small cracks.
Row 3: (7) pale yellow beach sand with a few small pebbles; (8) dark grey weathered stone with chisel marks; (9) white painted wooden boat planks with thin dark seams.
The materials are for a small stone fishing harbour on a fictional island in a northern sea (only the materials, not the scene).
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: square 1:1.

Style: a frame from a cel-shaded (toon-shaded) 3D adventure video game. Repaint the attached image in this style and keep its exact layout, camera and every object with its position and proportions. Toon shading: every surface is flat colour with two or three hard-edged tones (lit, mid, shadow), no soft gradients on objects; crisp dark ink outlines around all objects and along major edges; a thin bright rim light along silhouettes; simple, clean, readable shapes, playful and inviting. Saturated dusk palette: indigo-violet sky fading to coral and a band of orange at the horizon, warm orange sunlight from the left on lit faces, cool violet shadows; stylised flat clouds with glowing orange undersides; stylised deep blue water with light cyan wave strokes and clean white foam lines where the water touches the boats, posts, rocks and the quay wall. The lighthouse lamp only as a small glowing spot without any beam, no smoke from the chimney (both are animated separately). Not a photograph, not a realistic render, not a painting with visible brush texture.
Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.
Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: landscape 3:2.
